The '''Imperial Infiltration Specialists''' were a unit within the [[Sith Intelligence]] organization of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After being impressed by his skill, [[Darth Xarion]] placed [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Qrukk]] in charge of the unit and sent them to participate in the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="Qrukk" />
